'''Looker's Croagunk''' (Japanese: '''ハンサムのグレッグル''' ''Handsome's Gureggru'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by {{adv|Looker}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}.

==In the manga==
===History===
[[File:Looker and Croagunk Adventures.png|thumb|150px|left|Croagunk and Looker]]
===={{chap|Diamond & Pearl}}====
{{p|Croagunk}} first appeared in ''[[PS415|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V]]'' alongside its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, {{adv|Looker}}. The two interrogated two {{tc|scientist}}s who had been hired by [[Team Galactic]] to guard [[Lake Valor]], trying to find information about the location of Team Galactic members who had disappeared from [[Veilstone City]]. Gaining no information from the two scientists, Looker decided to leave, placing Croagunk in charge of guarding the police station.

===={{chap|Platinum}}====
Croagunk reappeared in ''[[PS441|The Final Dimensional Duel XI]]'', helping Looker arrest [[Charon]]. Croagunk helped its Trainer chase after the other Team Galactic commanders until Looker's superior contacted him and told him to call the mission off. Looker was ordered to head to [[Unova]] and investigate the activities of the [[Seven Sages]]. Looker and Croagunk then quickly head to Unova.

===={{chap|Black & White}}====
[[File:Black vs Looker Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Croagunk in the Pokémon League]]
In ''[[PS513|Into the Quarterfinals!]]'', Looker appeared as a participant in the {{un|Pokémon League}} tournament, disguised as a man named Lou Karr. Looker used Croagunk as his first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in a 3-on-3 battle against {{adv|Black}}'s [[Tula]] in the quarterfinals. Due to Croagunk not being native to the [[Unova]] [[region]], many of the spectators were unaware of what type of Pokémon it was. Black was able to deduce that his opponent was a {{t|Fighting}} [[type]], but Tula was nevertheless nailed in place and {{status|poisoned}} by Croagunk's poison needles, allowing Croagunk to strike him repeatedly. Black was, however, able to make a comeback by having Tula pull his airborne {{m|Electroweb}} down onto Croagunk with his thread, shocking Croagunk and defeating it, making Black the winner of the battle.

With their defeat, the two immediately disappeared into the stands and began to look for one of the Seven Sages. The two reviewed their data of those participating in the League and find [[Zinzolin|Gray]] to be the most suspicious. During the [[PS518|final match]] of the tournament, Looker discovered that Gray is a member of [[Team Plasma]] and had Croagunk quickly arrest him using the International Police Arm #10, Super Hard Tight Tape. After Team Plasma's arrival, Croagunk helped support Black by attacking {{adv|N}}'s {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}} alongside [[Cedric Juniper]]'s {{p|Samurott}} and [[Leo]]'s {{p|Deino}}. Despite their combined efforts Zekrom easily pushed them aside.

===={{chap|Black 2 & White 2}}====
[[File:Looker arresting Giallo Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|Croagunk and Looker arresting Giallo]]
After the battle against Team Plasma, Looker and Croagunk spent the next two years looking around the world for the Seven Sages. Having no success, the two [[PS525|return]] to Unova to continue their search and meet with {{adv|Blake}}. 

In ''[[PS526|Mr. Perfect]]'', Blake had Croagunk test its skill in simulated training. Blake started Croagunk with just targets, where the {{pkmn|category|Toxic Mouth Pokémon}} was able to hit all of the targets weak points. Blake then had Croagunk try while sand and fire flew around it, where it missed every shot, causing Blake to berate Looker. Immediately following the training, Team Plasma's {{TP|Blake|Genesect}} began attacking [[Aspertia City]]. While Blake and his {{TP|Blake|Dewott}} attacked the Paleozoic Pokémon, Looker and Croagunk went to secure the area. 

In ''[[PS533|New Sword Player]]'', after Blake defeated Team Plasma's {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}}, Looker and Croagunk arrested [[Giallo]].

In ''[[PS535|Angry Boy]]'', Looker used Croagunk to contact [[Hugh]] and attempted to have him explain his connection to Team Plasma, but Hugh refused and ran away.

In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', Croagunk assisted in defeating [[Ghetsis]]'s Pokémon on the [[Plasma Frigate]]. Soon after, the ship began to crash and Looker, getting a call from headquarters, failed to get onto {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} to escape. Right as they were about to crash, Croagunk pushed Looker towards [[Brav]], who carried the two to safety.

===Personality and characteristics===
Croagunk is a powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, being Looker's main choice for any situation. Croagunk is highly trained, able to easily hit a Pokémon's weak spot. Croagunk is often seen with Looker, being his main partner in the [[International Police]]. Croagunk is sometimes embarrassed by its {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s quirks and personality. Looker and Croagunk have a close relationship, highly trusting each other.

==In animation==
==={{aniseries|HZ}}===
In ''[[HZ113|Mega Evolution - Ult]]'', a photo of [[Looker]] and Croagunk is seen at [[Emma]]'s restaurant while she was talking to [[Roy]] about her past.

===Pokémon Generations===
[[File:Looker Croagunk PG.png|250px|thumb|Croagunk in Pokémon Generations]]
Looker's Croagunk appeared in the [[Pokémon Generations]] episode ''[[PG12|The Magma Stone]]'', helping Looker attack [[Team Galactic]]. Croagunk battled against the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{p|Heatran}} that [[Charon]] had awakened, pushing it back with powerful punches. The Toxic Mouth Pokémon then quickly subdued two {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s. While [[Buck]] attempted to put the [[Magma Stone]] back in its place, Croagunk kept Heatran busy, assaulting it with multiple {{m|Mud Bomb}} attacks.

== In the core series games ==

=== {{game|Platinum}} ===
Croagunk is [[Looker]]'s only known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Though Looker does not battle with or against the player during the entirety of the game, he uses Croagunk to get the [[Magma Stone]] from [[Charon]] at [[Stark Mountain]].

=== [[Pokémon X and Y]] ===
In these games, it is said that Looker's Pokémon was killed, but it is not specified whether the Pokémon in question is Croagunk or a different one. The picture on his table said that Looker wore bluish and purplish color clothes, which may be a reference to Croagunk.
